snippet.title: The Void Between ~ Live-action horror, puzzle game  ~ Coming soon to Steam
snippet.description:
One one man’s holiday turns into a nightmare, it’s up to you to save him from himself.

The Void Between is an FMV Horror Puzzle game being developed by two brothers from England (one of which is the scarily handsome actor btw).
You can play the extended demo during Steam Scream 4 Fest, it would be great to hear your feedback. 🕹

You can check out the new demo & Wishlist the game here -
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2678440/The_Void_Between/

See you in The Void!
